rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for being in or going to various places.

example.english: Walk around and you'll see convenience stores everywhere.
example.traditional: 周圍行吓都見到便利店。
example.jyutping: zau1 wai4 haang4 haa5 dou1 gin3 dou2 bin6 lei6 dim3

rows.note: Use this when stressing every individual place in the area under discussion.

example.english: There are people lining up for milk tea everywhere.
example.traditional: 度度都有人排隊買奶茶。
example.jyutping: dou6 dou6 dou1 jau5 jan4 paai4 deoi6 maai5 naai5 caa4
